title: Global $ C^{1}$ regularity for degenerate fully nonlinear elliptic equations
summary: In this paper, we prove global $ C^{1}$ regularity for Dirichlet problem of a class of degenerate fully nonlinear elliptic equations on $ C^{2}$ domain. This corresponds to the boundary counterpart of the interior $ C^{1}$ regularity results by \cite{APPT22} and \cite{AN25}. By an example, we show that $ C^{1, α}$ regularity of boundary datum is sharp within the scale of Hölder spaces. Furthermore, we also provide boundary $ C^{1, β}$ regularity for a class of singular fully nonlinear elliptic equations.
